rgod-01-c1.text: Barry Kemp (Amarna Project) (2026). Boundary Stelae. Amarna Project.
rgod-01-c1.quote: It was marked out by a series of tablets or stelae carved into the cliffs and escarpment on both sides.
rgod-01-c1.claim: Boundary stelae cut into the surrounding cliffs fix the city's limits and record his wish to be buried there.
